---
name: Bug report
description: Report incorrect, broken, misleading, or incomplete AI Engineer Pack content
title: "Bug: "
labels: [bug, needs-triage]
assignees: []
---

## Summary
Describe the problem clearly. Focus on the specific pack file, workflow, template, checklist, command, framework, or skill that is incorrect or broken.

## Affected area
Select all that apply:

- [ ] `system/`
- [ ] `routers/`
- [ ] `frameworks/`
- [ ] `commands/`
- [ ] `chatgpt/`
- [ ] `codex/`
- [ ] `skills/`
- [ ] `templates/`
- [ ] `checklists/`
- [ ] `examples/`
- [ ] `docs/`
- [ ] `.github/`
- [ ] Other

## File or folder
Provide the exact path, such as:

```text
frameworks/react/README.md
skills/web/react/PROMPTS.md
templates/fastapi/README.md
```

## Current behavior
Explain what the file currently says or does that is wrong, confusing, incomplete, duplicated, or hard to use.

## Expected behavior
Describe what a correct, useful, production-quality version should do instead.

## Evidence or example
Include a short excerpt, screenshot, command output, broken link, or reproduction steps. Keep excerpts short and quote only what is needed.

## Impact
Who is affected?

- [ ] ChatGPT users
- [ ] Codex users
- [ ] GitHub Copilot users
- [ ] OpenAI Agents users
- [ ] Maintainers
- [ ] New contributors
- [ ] Other AI coding assistants

Explain the practical risk, such as misleading prompts, broken navigation, missing verification, unsafe guidance, or poor contributor experience.

## Suggested fix
If you know the fix, describe it. Pull requests are welcome; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening one.

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues for a duplicate.
- [ ] I included the affected path.
- [ ] I described expected behavior.
- [ ] I included evidence, an example, or reproduction details.
